key_impacts: NTC assumed control over most of the country in late August 2011 (regime change).
Previously inaccessible areas in the Nafusa Mountains during the conflict became accessible after NTC control.
Orthopaedic and trauma services were supported at Nalut Hospital during the height of the conflict.
evidence_snippets: Emergency response in the Nafusa mountains in response to the civil crisis that erupted in February 2011.
Supported orthopaedic and trauma services in Nalut Hospital during the height of the conflict.
NTC assumption of control over most of the country in late August.
